printer: Original Prusa XL Input Shaper 0.4 nozzle
supports: Automatic snug, build plate only, Z contact 0.2 mm, XY separation 0.35 mm
review: Both final toolpaths viewed in Prusa G-code Viewer, including interior support cutaways. Roof/tray support coverage observed. STL info reports each half manifold, one part. No physical print or snap-force test performed. Narrow vents bridge; remove all supports before assembly.

bottom_snap_gap_check.method: Sampled straight support extrusion centerlines at <=0.1 mm intervals within print Z 0.2..14 mm; X gap |x|=35.0..35.2 mm and Y within each 7.2 mm tongue width, coordinates relative to bed center (180,180). Arc segments excluded.
